name: student-insight
description: Privacy-first, offline, in-browser student analytics. Static site, no build step, no backend. This file exists purely so dependency versions are visible to Dependabot/npm audit — nothing here is actually installed or bundled; all libraries load from pinned CDN <script> tags in index.html. Version policy: the CDN version pins in index.html (SRI on xlsx-js-style/jsPDF/JSZip/GSAP; Chart.js is version-pinned without SRI) are authoritative at runtime; the ranges below intentionally track newer releases so Dependabot/npm audit flag security fixes to upgrade the CDN pins to.

scripts.test:loader-cards: echo 'Needs a static file server on 127.0.0.1:8899 first, e.g.: python3 -m http.server 8899 --bind 127.0.0.1' && node dev-tests/verify-loader-cards.cjs
scripts.check:all: npm run check:cycles && npm run check:layers && npm run check:sw && npm run lint:i18n && npm run test:engine && npm run test:completeness && npm run test:report-views && npm run test:smart-plan
scripts.test:smart-plan: node dev-tests/test-smart-plan-eligibility.mjs && node dev-tests/test-smart-plan-prompt.mjs && node dev-tests/test-smart-plan-parser.mjs
